mechanism_fidelity.rationale: Repeated matched measurements under held settings, evaluated against baseline and a consecutive-measurement alert, preserve the sequence-to-temporal-pattern-to-bounded-inference chain. Reliable sampling and comparable controls are stipulated; concurrent inputs, mix shifts and the observation horizon remain explicit limits.

target_fidelity.rationale: The cohort error trajectory directly contributes to assessing segment deterioration. The mapping specifies follow-up observations and an investigation alert, providing a bounded contribution to the requested next decision without claiming causal proof.

operational_coherence.rationale: Four initial samples and two follow-up samples fit the six-sample, six-hour budget. Matched trajectories can reveal persistence or reversal, and consecutive error measurements above 3 percent warrant the stated investigation alert. The mapping does not establish a definitive pause rule or causal diagnosis.

validity.rationale: The mapping preserves serial monitoring and coherently addresses the retained question through bounded temporal evidence and a specified observation and investigation procedure.

uncertainty: The response trajectory is unobserved, so the packet does not establish whether deterioration persists or the alert will trigger.
Six hours cannot establish long-run behavior or a unique causal mechanism, and replica findings may not generalize.
The alert is a stated investigation rule; its predictive performance and the circumstances warranting a pause are not established.
